mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

This project uses Semantic Versioning (SemVer) for its version numbers. The recorded reason for the decision is that SemVer gives users much clearer signals about compatibility when they update.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
